title: Settings: Keys & secrets
summary: DJDL's Settings → Keys & secrets, ordered by exposure: the public key set, signing keys with the rotation stepper (djdl-2026b in its trust window until Nov 3), sealed secrets by name only, CI publishing (the trusted publisher and a pkeyci_ token with scope, last use and expiry, one fact per line), and read-only content keys. Every write asks the person to confirm it's them.
compare: Sections run from public to sealed to one-time (admin-4-12, study 375): Verification, Signing keys, Secrets, CI publishing, Content keys; no Platform 'Tokens' page (ST-34).
Every row says its last use; what a revoke stops ('revoking stops plugins.yml') is said in its confirmation, not on the row; revoke is a danger-outline button, never the primary.

Signing is gold only through the signed badge (key glyph and name); the rotation stepper is Prepared → Trust window → Activate → Old key retires, with Activate disabled until the window ends and why in words.
Secrets list names only; a missing required secret says what it breaks.
No line under the tabs announces the step-up: the confirmation (admin.confirm-step-up) asks when a change is made.
The hub keeps four underline tabs and DJDL's icon as the masthead mark; spelling is 'Keys & secrets' everywhere (admin-4-22).
